title: Vampire Vape Strawberry Kiwi E-Liquid 10ml
description: Get your taste buds flowing with the mouthwatering Vampire Vape Strawberry Kiwi E-Liquid 10ml. With each puff, you can immerse yourself in the perfect balance of freshly picked Strawberries and tangy, juicy Kiwis. That has been expertly blended to create a 10ml e-liquid that delivers an unrivalled level of refreshment. The impeccable balance of flavours in this Strawberry Kiwi Vampire Vape 10ml e-liquid ensures a vaping experience that is both satisfying and refreshing. So, Whether you're a mouth to lung vaper or simply craving a sweet, juicy and refreshing vape, this Strawberry Kiwi blend is sure to become your go-to choice. Each bottle of this Strawberry Kiwi by Vampire Vape offers a balanced blend of PG (Propylene Glycol) and VG (Vegetable Glycerin). Ensuring that it can deliver maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. Please note: that the specific PG/VG ratio varies depending on the nicotine strength in each bottle of nicotine E Liquid. For the 3mg nicotine strength, the E-Liquid has a 50VG/50PG ratio. Whilst the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg nicotine strengths contain a 40VG/60PG ratio. Strawberry Kiwi Vampire Vape is a versatile blend that can be used with most vape devices to deliver a satisfying vaping experience. Making it ideal for use with low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits, and pod kits. If you love this 10ml bottle of Vampire Vape juice, why not explore their other equally delicious popular flavours. Their iconic E-Liquid collection offers a broad range to choose from to suit a variety of vaping needs. So whether you're looking for your next seriously smooth nicotine salt Vampire Vape Nic Salt for a perfectly smooth throat hit. Or inspired to make your own vape juice blends with their Vampire Vape Flavour Concentrates. You're sure to find a vape juice flavour and type that suits your vaping needs.
